galleryInfo: Graffiti Pasta is proud to showcase local artists. We support independent creators and promote their work. Shop what you love.
inHouseNote: Available for purchase in-house at Graffiti Pasta Denton.

artists.name: Gabriel
artists.bio: Gabriel is a local Denton artist who has been a friend of Graffiti Pasta from day one. We showcase his art currently on our walls which you can purchase here or in house.

artists.name: Artist Till Death (ATD)
artists.intro: Artist Till Death is a local artist group that does all custom hats for Graffiti Pasta. Each hat is one of a kind hand painted and airbrushed. You can purchase these hats in house at Graffiti Pasta. Just ask your bartender.
artists.bio: Looking for bold, soulful, and unforgettable art? You just found it. These are the finished, framed, and ready-to-hang masterpieces straight from the studio of Jeff and Erika Thornton—two artists who live and breathe creativity. From large-scale statement pieces to intimate works full of detail and heart, every painting is a window into the madness and magic of the Artist Till Death world.
artists.ctaText: Check out ATD's work and follow them on Instagram

artworks.title: Frankie
artworks.description: In this image you can look directly into the monsters eyes and see his pain and sorrow. You can feel his journey to finding peace within himself and within all of man that surrounds him.

artworks.title: Graffiti Pasta Skateboard Sign
artworks.description: This was an idea that we brought to ATD for a custom piece. When asked, all we said was two skateboards, one that says GRAFFITI and the other that said PASTA. What we got was something that was above and beyond our artistic vision and more than we could have asked for. This piece is now located smack in the middle of our bar in Denton as a main focus piece that really ties the room together.

artworks.title: Sexy Storm Trooper
artworks.description: This is drawn with charcoal and was a piece that was created for May the Fourth.

artworks.title: Trooper Reservoir Hip-Hop Dogs
artworks.description: Two great movies, connected by a culture of music to bring into one new universe. Fun and simple.

artists.name: DETOX (Jerod Davies)
artists.intro: DETOX is the main artist who tagged the interior of Graffiti Pasta in the Denton location. His signature spans from the main mural in the kitchen, to the mural down in the basement and all the corners, benches, and everywhere in between.
artists.bio: JEROD DAVIES aka DTOX is a multifaceted self-taught artist raised in Dallas, Texas by way of Grand Rapids, Michigan. Coming from a long line of visual artists in his immediate family Jerod moves comfortably between styles and excels naturally at his use of color and ornate application. His passionate approach at creating art is fueled by a deeply rooted attraction for unconventional beauty. Heavily influenced by nature, his style is virtually impossible to categorize yet easy to describe, bold portraits, believable and surreal, direct yet ornate with a vibrant sarcasm.

artworks.title: Little Corners
artworks.description: We wanted to make part of the basement feel like you were on a rooftop in a major city at night looking at other rooftops around you and also wanted a wall that was just tagged over like it had been getting tagged by multiple artists year after year.

artworks.title: Main Mural
artworks.description: We asked Detox to put a mural that would represent our city, Denton TX and infuse the pasta life culture. We really just let him go and create and he did an amazing image of the Denton courthouse that sits right across the street from us.

artworks.title: Basement Mural
artworks.description: This was a mural that we wanted to showcase one of our favorite style of logos, the AC/DC style logo.

artworks.title: Pasta Life
artworks.description: Detox loves putting little doodles all over the place in our building. The more you look, the more you find. Pasta Life is our culture here at Graffiti Pasta and Detox splashed it in the right spots of our restaurant.
